method: Each of the 50 golden queries was read against all 32 official FAQs (scripts/faq/official-faqs.json). A label means the FAQ's answer text contains what the query asks: 'clear' if it answers it, 'partial' if it answers a substantive part or is ambiguous. Judged from the FAQ text and the query alone, before any retrieval output was consulted for these pairs; conservative on purpose.
caveat: Not owner-verified and not independent of the assistant that built the harness. Use only to make FAQ answers visible to the recall metric (audit §17). Do NOT use it alone to justify a retrieval change; prefer the clear-only figure. Kept apart from golden_set_verified.jsonl so the verified set is not contaminated.
